responsibility: Represent, normalize, validate and select legal autonomous process transitions without becoming an authority, Action, PDP, runtime-admission or effect plane.

boundaries.mission: MissionSpec declares mission purpose/capability/organization constraints; ProcessIR declares lifecycle transitions.
boundaries.epoch: EvolutionaryEpochEngine remains a specialized domain state machine and is not replaced by LPCL.
boundaries.authority: ProcessIR may declare authority requirements but cannot validate/mint downstream grants.
boundaries.reconciliation: Evidence-bound ProcessTransitionOutcome may justify the next ProcessState.
